description: Nebraska DHHS childcare ArcGIS metadata and two fixed center-only aggregate requests; no facility rows.

output_schema_contract.scope: License_Type IN ('Child Care Center','Provisional Child Care Center')
output_schema_contract.row_unit: historical/current-source aggregate cohort only; zero facility rows
output_schema_contract.temporal_semantics: Roster_Date is a source date-only value; aggregate requests are sequential and not an atomic snapshot; no current-operation inference
output_schema_contract.identity_and_geography: No facility identifiers, addresses, ZIPs, coordinates, geocoding, or coverage outputs

redirect_policy: Exact five static URLs only; reject all redirects and URL drift.
retry: No retries, redirects, alternate hosts, fallback queries, or feature/ID requests.
checkpoint: Transient bodies are parsed in memory and discarded; sanitized hashes, lengths, status, metadata summary, and aggregate values only.
idempotency: Immutable UUID intent and receipt; manifest published last without overwrite.
cancellation: Cooperative abort during spacing, request, and response-body reads; no manifest on incomplete operation; verify retained bundle before use.
retention_profile: Internal source metadata and two center-only aggregate results; no provider rows or contacts.
